8:50pm And so, a long, never-ending match has finished in a thriller! And it was down to 
the experienced Mushfiqur to get them over the line. It never seemed as if his heroics 
would be needed when Shanto was going out all guns blazing along with Hridoy. The 
pair never let the required run rate go out of hand and kept Bangladesh in the game. But 
once they both fell - with Shanto having scored a fantastic, maiden ODI ton - the game 
was open. Ireland squeezed in some economical overs and took it to the last over. Adair 
almost did it by dismissing Mushfiqur, only for it to be a waist-high no-ball. And rest, as 
they say, is history. Bangladesh are 1-0 up with a game to go. Presentations soon. 
nzbsz: "10 points and Bangladesh moved to the third position in the point table. Another 
10 won't change it much but the morale will be high. " 
Andy Balbirnie, Ireland Captain: Hard one to pinpoint, will sit down tomorrow and look 
at it. It's a tough ground to defend, credit to them for the chase. We can take a lot of 
confidence. When you have a good score, you're in the game. Can't fault batters. 
Shoutout to Tector. I wouldn't look too much into him making tons in losing causes. 
He'll score more in wins. Bangladesh have a great team. We were good but not enough. 
We entertained the crowd, hope to do it on Sunday. 
Tamim Iqbal, Bangladesh Captain: The support is unbelievable when we played in 
England. I remember our crowd outnumbered England in 2017, it's special. Due to the 
ground dimensions and the wicket, we thought it was chaseable. It's not a ground where 
you need to look for a boundary all the time, they will come. Kudos to Shanto. If Towhid 
keeps performing the way he does, he will be gold. 
Najmul Hossain Shanto, POTM: I feel very happy, it was nice. I think Hridoy batted well. 
His intent helped me. It's pretty cold but we can't control conditions. We just focus on 
our game. We didn't feel we were outside Bangladesh, thanks to the crowd. Hopefully 
they can come in the next match as well. He later thanks the crowd for coming in 
Bangla, his native tongue. 
Bangladesh take a 1-0 lead but both teams continued to breathe life into the ODI format 
and entertained a vociferous crowd in Chelmsford. The game was curtailed and it went 
overtime but delivered top-quality cricket that signal exciting times ahead. We'll do this 
all over again in a couple of days, see you then. Goodbye for now from me, Ekanth, my 
co-commentator, S Sudarshanan, and our scorers, Binoy George and Chandan Duorah.
